gaps.quote: is a primitive $\ell$-th root of unity
gaps.note: The reader cannot check this from the page. It needs ell to divide 2r, and y^{2r}=1 (which the reduction of the exponent eta modulo 2r also needs). The page shows neither, and asserts that y^{2r/ell} has order exactly ell.

The page shows that a common factor commutes with a butterfly. It does not show how the per-axis twiddles multiply into the single exponent eta, summed over all participating axes, or why the axis steps can be taken one at a time.
The sentence stops before saying how. The reader cannot check how multiplying by y^delta is carried out.
